reviews.body:
Many providers use a common client interface but only support certain parameters in the actual requests depending on the model capabilities, most support a `max_tokens`, however `temperature` and `top_p` are more often rejected for the latest _reasoning_ models. I am not sure if Mistral services are responding with error HTTP codes, suppressing passed parameters servers side or presenting some other failure mode.

For this reason I would suggest this enhancement should also come with suppression support in the form of a default option like this one in `openai.OpenAICompatible`:
https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/blob/725160beb8137a8294c79b1f78c68a756367f861/garak/generators/openai.py#L153

Which filters parameters based on user provided config here:
https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/blob/725160beb8137a8294c79b1f78c68a756367f861/garak/generators/openai.py#L317-L319
